name: anki
description: Create and edit Anki flashcards as version-controlled YAML — pushed into live Anki via AnkiConnect, synced to your devices through AnkiWeb, with git history as the audit trail.
author: Bailey Wickham

name: geo
description: Answer geospatial questions from OpenStreetMap data — routing with quietest/flattest preferences, geocoding, elevation profiles, isochrones, and Overpass queries — via the geo CLI.
author: Bailey Wickham

name: unifi-cli
description: Answer questions about your UniFi network (gateway, APs, connected clients) by driving the unifi CLI against the local gateway's Integrations API.
author: Bailey Wickham

name: ibkr
description: Research and trade options and stocks on Interactive Brokers via a local CLI — chains, quotes, Greeks, and limit orders with a preview/confirm/execute safety protocol. Requires IB Gateway.
author: Bailey Wickham
